comment: The delay line has a fixed internal feedback: the second syncopated tap is scaled by 0.4, low-passed and written back in (V103-Reverb_Delay.cpp:197-198). There is no control for it. The reverb's size and tone are hard-coded at 0.7 (V103-Reverb_Delay.cpp:311-312), so only the BIG/SML switch changes the space. The maximum delay is half a second, set as AUDIO_FS * 0.5. DEL_SW and REV_SW are added with addChild rather than addParam, but the census still finds their positions, so both can be clicked.
